Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the PaymentFactory interface where the create method has two Date parameters without disambiguation using @Assisted annotations. This will cause issues when using Guice for dependency injection.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which internally uses a PaymentFactory to create a RealPayment object with two Date parameters of the same type without disambiguating them using named @Assisted annotations.
